help.title: Help & Support
help.hero_sub: Find answers to common questions below, or reach out to our support team.
help.faq_1_q: How do I create a new project?
help.faq_1_a: From the Home tab, tap the "Create Project" card at the top. Fill in the project details including name, location, and budget, then tap Save.
help.faq_2_q: How does the calculation engine work?
help.faq_2_a: Navigate to the Calculations tab inside a project. Choose a category (e.g., Foundations), then a sub-category, enter your dimensions, and tap Calculate. Results are displayed immediately and can be saved to your project history.
help.faq_3_q: Can I use the app offline?
help.faq_3_a: Yes! Calculations and saved project data are stored locally on your device. You only need an internet connection to log in, sync projects, or use the AI assistant.
help.faq_4_q: How do I change the app language?
help.faq_4_a: Go to Settings → Language. You can switch between English and Arabic. The app will update immediately without needing to restart.
help.faq_5_q: How do I reset my password?
help.faq_5_a: On the login screen, tap "Forgot Password". Enter your email address, and you'll receive a 6-digit OTP code. Enter the code, then set your new password.
help.faq_6_q: Are prices in the calculations accurate?
help.faq_6_a: The calculations use reference unit prices based on Algerian market averages. They are meant for estimation only. Always consult local suppliers for current prices.
help.faq_7_q: How do I delete a project?
help.faq_7_a: Open the project, then tap the options menu (three dots) in the top right corner. You'll see a "Delete Project" option. This action is permanent.
help.faq_8_a: When you mark a project as "Completed", all its calculations become read-only (locked). This preserves a final archive of the estimation for that project.

privacy_page.section_1_content: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, create construction projects, and use our estimation tools. This includes your name, email, and project data.
privacy_page.section_2_content: We use your data to provide, maintain, and improve Apex services. Specifically, your project data is used to generate accurate estimates and technical reports using our calculation modules.
privacy_page.section_3_content: We implement robust security measures to protect your personal and project information. All data is encrypted during transmission and stored securely in our cloud infrastructure.
privacy_page.section_4_content: When you use our AI estimation features, anonymized project parameters may be processed to improve our mathematical models. We never share your personal identity with third-party AI services.
privacy_page.section_5_content: We do not sell your personal data. We may share information only with trusted service providers who help us operate our platform, such as hosting services or email providers.
privacy_page.section_6_content: You have the right to access, update, or delete your account and project data at any time through your profile settings or by contacting our support team.
privacy_page.footer: If you have any questions about how your data is handled, please contact our privacy officer at privacy@apex.com

privacy_auth.section_1_content: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as account details and project estimation data, to provide and improve our services.
privacy_auth.section_2_content: Your estimation data is used only within the app for your projects. We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties.
privacy_auth.section_3_content: Some project data is stored locally on your device for offline access. You can clear this data through the application settings or by deleting the app.
privacy_auth.section_4_content: We take reasonable measures to protect your data from loss, theft, and unauthorized access.
